description: Gets a neatly report by its link or id. Before the full report is unlocked: the verdict, each charge with its number of points and strongest stamp, the dispute estimate and the reply deadline. Once unlocked (paid, or free because the bill was fair): every finding, what the bill charged, the evidence to ask for, where to escalate and replies ready to send. After payment it returns the full report.

report_url.description: The report link or its id
